lines.text: ZONAGE DE LA RESERVE DE BIOSPHERE

notes: Painted entrance board with a hand-drawn zoning map of the Mare aux Hippopotames biosphere reserve; target is the two-line title band (the small 'de la' and 'aux' are lower-case-height capitals). The map labels, legend ('Légende', ...) and the orange 'ZONAGE DE LA R.B.M.H' area table are distractors. location is where the photo was taken (Commons camera coordinates), not the target.

author: Jeff Attaway
attribution: Photo: Jeff Attaway, CC BY 2.0, via Flickr. Source: https://www.flickr.com/photos/33398364@N08/3331000424. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/2.0/. Unmodified original.
notes: Large park entrance board in Ouagadougou on a steel frame, with a painted park map below. The Mooré name has a tilde on the A (BÃNGR); the usual map spelling is Bangr-Weoogo. The small strapline is transcribed as seen ('Education' shows no accent; spacing around the first hyphen as on the board). Distractors: 'BURKINA FASO / Unité-Progrès-Justice' with the coat of arms at top right, 'COMMUNE DE OUAGADOUGOU', the round park logo and the tiny map labels.

author: Tidjanehema
attribution: Photo: Tidjanehema, CC BY-SA 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Plaque_Entr%C3%A9e_D%C3%B4mes.jpg. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/. Unmodified original.
notes: Blue name strip under a large dark picture board at the entrance to the Fabédougou domes site near Banfora; moderately small in frame. A tourist pictogram sits at the strip's left; the red STOP sign at upper left and the picnic pictogram at right are distractors.

author: Ji-Elle
attribution: Photo: Ji-Elle, CC BY-SA 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Ouagadougou-H%C3%B4tel_du_Maire_(1).jpg. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/. Unmodified original.
notes: Long white metal panel on a wall, Ouagadougou; green 'HOTEL DU MAIRE' (no accent) between two AMBF logos (A and M in red, BF in green) with a Burkina Faso outline.

author: Jeff Attaway
attribution: Photo: Jeff Attaway, CC BY 2.0, via Flickr. Source: https://www.flickr.com/photos/33398364@N08/4085806167. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/2.0/. Unmodified original.
notes: Red-bordered French-style town entry sign above a 50 speed-limit sign on the roadside. The 50 roundel and the truck's plate are distractors.

author: Jeff Attaway
attribution: Photo: Jeff Attaway, CC BY 2.0, via Flickr. Source: https://www.flickr.com/photos/33398364@N08/3581216910. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/2.0/. Unmodified original.
notes: Yellow-on-white supermarket sign on the right of the building, Ouagadougou. The phone line is small; spacing within the numbers is approximate. The Bridel/Catch product billboards on the facade and the faded 'SCIMAS SUPERMARCHE' lettering on the awning are distractors.

expect.query: Centre de Valorisation des Déchets Plastiques

notes: Hand-painted facility sign, Ouagadougou; initial letters in red, the rest black; no accents painted (PROPRETE, DECHETS, REGION). The I in 'VILLE DE TURIN' is faded. Small logos between the lines carry no extra legible text.
